eva: FYI from today's shadow of v6.0-quant4: overall lift neutral but a consistent hit on the long-context slice (~4.8% rel MRR down). Want to pin a safety latch before any traffic split. :warning:

 raj: Numbers? slice counts and CI?

 eva: Control (v5.9 fp16) long-context 7.6k, variant (v6.0 q4) 2.0k. Long-context MRR control 0.410 -> variant 0.390 (rel -4.9%). Bootstrap 95% lower ~ -0.041.

 mia: Any token-level weirdness? truncation? kv-cache mismatch?

 eva: Top regressions show a mix: some prompt suffix clipping, some output-word-drop at ~2k+ tokens. I uploaded sample pairs to artifacts.

 samir: Suggest a compact rule set: (1) per-slice minima, (2) CI-lower comparator via Optimize bootstrap, (3) ensemble requirement (MRR + accept_rate) for auto-rollback, (4) fast-proxy checks for entropy/length.

 raj: Draft latch policy (short):
```
policy_name: quant4-safety-latch-v1
global_min: 1000
slices:
  long-context:
    min_samples: 450
    metric: mrr
    rel_abort_thresh: -0.03
    allow_auto_rollback: true
window_sec: 1800
consecutive_windows: 3
ensemble: require 2 metrics (mrr, accept_rate)
fast_fail: entropy_drop_pct>20 && mrr_rel<-0.02 -> immediate_hold
notify: channel:#eng-ml, pager:oncall
```

 mia: Two tweaks: (a) use bootstrap lower bound <= rel_abort_thresh, (b) cap consecutive_windows at 5 and include a min_effect_size 0.01 to avoid tiny noisy trips.

 samir: Also add hysteresis: if variant recovers above -1% in two windows, suppress rollback and escalate. And add cooldown 4h after any auto-rollback to prevent flapping.

 deploy-bot: [system] I can schedule a dry-canary run and create policy draft "quant4-safety-latch-v1". Confirm run time?

 eva: Schedule dry-canary tomorrow 06:00 UTC. Action items: eva attach samples + ticket, mia run token-diff on top 200 pairs, raj update policy PR with bootstrap comparator + min_effect, samir wire Optimize bootstrap into the canary checker and add hysteresis/cooldown, deploy-bot run dry-canary and post artifacts.

 raj: I'll also add a small smoke-run that does N=500 paired evals for long-context before allowing any split >5%.

 eva: Good. Keep the promote button disabled until the latch is in place. :lock:
